issue_title: Worsening sub-85 performance across 3 pages: TBT spike on / and rising LCP on all affected pages (day 6)
issue_body: ## Performance regression — TBT spike + persistent LCP bottleneck (day 6) Three pages are now below the 85 Lighthouse performance threshold, with conditions worsening compared to yesterday. | Page | Perf (prev) | Perf (now) | LCP | TBT | CLS | |------|-------------|------------|-----|-----|-----| | `/` | 84 | **75** | 3934 ms | **435 ms** | 0.015 | | `/projects/note-structurer` | 83 | **79** | 4352 ms | 197 ms | 0 | | `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 80 | **75** | 4842 ms | 192 ms | 0 | ### Notable changes today - **`/` TBT spiked from 140 ms → 435 ms** — the primary driver of the 9-point performance drop. This suggests a long task (third-party script, heavy animation, or late-loading JS bundle) blocking the main thread on mobile. - **`/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` LCP rose from 4330 ms → 4842 ms** — continued upward trend over multiple audits. - **`/projects/note-structurer` LCP rose from 3920 ms → 4352 ms** — second consecutive day of increase. ### Recommended fixes 1. **Investigate TBT spike on `/`** — profile the page on mobile to identify long tasks. Suspects: animated hero, particle canvas, or a third-party script loading synchronously. 2. **`fetchpriority="high"`** on each LCP `` element — ensures the browser prioritises the hero image. 3. **Preload LCP images** with `` in each page's ``. 4. **Audit image format/size** — confirm hero images are served as WebP/AVIF at mobile-appropriate resolutions. 5. **Defer or lazy-load non-critical JS** — especially any animation libraries that run on initial paint. ### Audit history (/) | Date | Perf | LCP | TBT | |------|------|-----|-----| | 2026-10-06 | 82 | ~4086 ms | ~70 ms | | 2026-10-07 | 82 | — | — | | 2026-10-08 | 83 | — | — | | 2026-10-09 | 82 | — | — | | 2026-10-10 | 84 | 3871 ms | 140 ms | | 2026-10-11 | **75** | 3934 ms | **435 ms** | _Automatically filed by nightly auditor — 2026-10-11T14:55:36.434Z_
